context: Evaluates whether the model correctly uses the Environment function from @wailsapp/runtime to retrieve build type, platform, and CPU architecture. The key challenge is knowing the exact function name and that it returns a Promise<EnvironmentInfo> with buildType, platform, and arch string fields.

checklist.name: Environment used
checklist.description: Environment from @wailsapp/runtime is called (with no arguments) inside getEnvironment

checklist.name: Promise forwarded
checklist.description: getEnvironment returns the Promise<EnvironmentInfo> from Environment without re-wrapping or modifying the resolved value

checklist.name: EnvironmentInfo shape
checklist.description: The implementation or its TypeScript types correctly reflect that the resolved object has buildType, platform, and arch string properties
